articles.title: Bitcoin short-term holders send 47K BTC to exchanges at a loss
articles.description: Bitcoin fell to an 11-week low of $72,670 after slipping below short-term holders’ average cost basis of about $75,700, according to CryptoQuant.

articles.title: How Democrats could snarl Trump administration stakes in private-sector companies

articles.description: Investors are assessing whether CEO Jensen Huang's affair will have spillover effects on Nvidia's business.

articles.description: The New York Stock Exchange will use Avalanche infrastructure, but experts say that won't necessarily boost AVAX's price.

articles.title: Kraken's xStocks adds 200 UK and EU shares as its assets top $1.1 billion

articles.description: Robert Barr planned to have accomplices force a crypto investor to install remote-access software so he could drain the wallet from prison.

articles.title: Bitmine posts $6.3B net loss for fiscal 2026 as Ether prices slide

articles.title: ECB warns legislative delays could postpone digital euro launch

articles.title: SEC enforcement actions fall 24%, crypto cases in spotlight
articles.description: The SEC filed 348 actions in fiscal 2026, down from 456 a year earlier. Cases included alleged Bitcoin mining fraud and an FTX audit settlement.

articles.description: During Xi's September visit, Washington and Beijing agreed to launch an AI dialogue with a communications channel to help defuse serious incidents.
